deductions.comment: sqrt(1 + 25 + 1) is evaluated as 27; the radical is dropped, and the norm is sqrt(27) = 3 sqrt(3) ≈ 5.20.
u · w is summed as 12, but -8 - 2 + 18 = 8, so cos θ = 2/7 and θ ≈ 73.40°.
wA is not boxed or labeled as the final answer.
vw and wv are not boxed or labeled as the final answer.
R3 → R3 - 3R1 gives the constant 10 - 3(4) = -2, not 0.
The slip flips the conclusion: the system is consistent with z free, so the free variable, the infinitely many solutions, and the parametric form are all lost.

overall_comment: Your method is sound in every problem; every point lost came from a single bad sum. Recheck each subtraction before you carry it: 10 - 3(4) = -2 in 3(b), not 0, and that one entry turned a consistent system into an inconsistent one and cost the whole part. Label the final answer in Problem 2(c) and 2(d) the way you did everywhere else.
